# witness

> Deterministic build gate: mutation + fuzz. Catches test-theatre and throw-on-malformed with no LLM, zero deps.

witness is an MIT-licensed build gate by Simon Gant (UK), supplied by AI Native Solutions. It runs in your own CI or on your own machine with Node: it flips one operator at a time in your source, runs your own tests, and names every line your tests would not notice changing. Each run mints a Proof-of-Play receipt anyone can re-run to get the same anchor hash. Zero dependencies, no network calls, free to own and fork. Source and a live page that explains itself are linked below.

## Key pages
